aberrant-heir.name: Aberrant Heir
aberrant-heir.info: Your aberrant dragonmark has made life hard. You may have hidden it well, or met fear and hostility from dragonmarked houses. You might have joined House Tarkanan's criminals, or you might walk your own road, trusting your wits and your mark to carry you.

academic.name: Academic
academic.info: skills Arcana, History; tool ; gear Book (history), Ink, Ink Pen, 10 sheets of Paper, Traveler's Clothes (casual), Wristwatch, 1 CR. Option B is 50 CR

agent-of-augustine.name: Agent of Augustine
agent-of-augustine.info: skills History, Persuasion; tool Forgery Kit; gear Forgery Kit, Book (history), Magnifying Glass, 10 sheets of Parchment, Robe, 8 GP

agent-of-the-ninth-quill.name: Agent of the Ninth Quill
agent-of-the-ninth-quill.info: Your sharp mind and thieving skill led you to the Ninth Quill, a network of thieves, saboteurs, and spies who take magical lore and relics from others. Stealing items and tomes and sabotaging mages taught you cunning and a few magical tricks for spy work.

amnesiac.name: Amnesiac
amnesiac.info: skills Insight, Investigation; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear Bedroll, Book (fiction), Traveler's Clothes, 22 GP

anthropologist.name: Anthropologist
anthropologist.info: You are fascinated by cultures, from ancient lost lands to modern cities. You studied customs, laws, rituals, beliefs, languages, and art to learn how societies shape their own fates. Books and scrolls taught you part of it, and visits to distant settlements t

antiquarian.name: Antiquarian
antiquarian.info: skills Arcana, History; tool Tinker's Tools; gear Dagger, Tinker's Tools, Ancient Maps, 10 sheets of Parchment, Robe, 8 GP

archaeologist.name: Archaeologist
archaeologist.info: You spent your life studying fallen cultures by visiting ruins, reading their records, and examining what they left behind. You may have trained at Morgrave University and worked in remote digs. Some archaeologists loot for fame or coin, but most feel called t

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.info: skills Arcana, Investigation; tool Calligrapher's Supplies; gear Calligrapher's Supplies, Leather-bound journal of research notes, Robes, 5 sheets of loose paper, Spectacles, Pouch, 15

aristocrat.name: Aristocrat
aristocrat.info: skills Deception, Persuasion; tool Gaming Set (choose one); gear Fine Clothes, Fine Wine (bottle), Gaming Set (same as above), Log Keeper, Perfume, 9 CR. Option B is 50 CR

artist.name: Artist
artist.info: skills Acrobatics, Performance; tool Musical Instrument or Painter's Supplies (choose one); gear Ink, Ink Pen, Musical Instrument or Painter's Supplies (same as above), 10 sheets of Paper, Traveler's Clothes (casual),

ashari.name: Ashari
ashari.info: skills Nature; tool Herbalism Kit; gear Traveler's Clothes, Staff, Herbalism Kit, Pouch, 10 GP

astral-drifter.name: Astral Drifter
astral-drifter.info: You have wandered the Astral Sea longer than you can recall. There you stopped aging, hunger, and thirst, and you drifted between its regions out of wanderlust. You have camped on the husks of dead gods, dodged psychic winds, and avoided the plane's deadliest

athlete.name: Athlete
athlete.info: You push yourself to perfect body and technique, and you feel alive in competition with a cheering crowd. Stories of your feats open doors and loosen tongues. In Theros, contests and those who pursue them earn near reverent respect, and athletes of every origi

augen-trust.name: Augen Trust
augen-trust.info: The Augen Trust is a secret network of imperial spies in the Dwendalian Empire, led by the gnome Oliver Schreiber, who alone knows every member. Betraying it is high treason, and defectors are hunted. If you are an adventurer, you either hid your identity or r

azorius-functionary.name: Azorius Functionary
azorius-functionary.info: You proudly serve the Azorius Senate, the guild that writes and enforces the laws of Ravnica. With brutes at the gate and chaos looming, you believe order is all that prevents disaster. You help keep the city running safely and smoothly.

baldurs-gate-acolyte.name: Baldur's Gate Acolyte
baldurs-gate-acolyte.info: Baldur's Gate holds believers of nearly every faith, with newcomers constantly arriving from distant lands. Most faiths are tolerated, though evil ones are pushed into the Twin Songs district. An acolyte from here might seek greater things, not for personal gl

baldurs-gate-charlatan.name: Baldur's Gate Charlatan
baldurs-gate-charlatan.info: In Baldur's Gate everyone tries to get ahead of someone else. One group's swindler is another's revolutionary, or perhaps you simply look out for yourself. Either way, you have a plan to hit it big, and all you need is nerve and a bit of time.

baldurs-gate-criminal.name: Baldur's Gate Criminal
baldurs-gate-criminal.info: Any career criminal in Baldur's Gate knows the Guild. Some keep quiet, slipping smuggled goods in with honest cargo, and others join crews or the Guild for protection. A few were thrown out for incompetence or for crossing someone powerful, and they now scrape

baldurs-gate-entertainer.name: Baldur's Gate Entertainer
baldurs-gate-entertainer.info: Baldur's Gate offers a colorful range of performers, from the Oasis Theater's singers and acrobats to the Wide's mimes and shadow puppeteers. Good acts always find audiences, and the steady stream of travelers brings both fresh spectators and fresh spectacles

baldurs-gate-folk-hero.name: Baldur's Gate Folk Hero
baldurs-gate-folk-hero.info: Baldur's Gate badly needs heroes, and now and then one rises from its own people. Locals love and remember such champions, but public opinion can turn on them nearly as fast as it first praised them.

baldurs-gate-guild-artisan.name: Baldur's Gate Guild Artisan
baldurs-gate-guild-artisan.info: Baldur's Gate has many guilds and professional groups, covering every trade you can name, from gravediggers to moneylenders. As an artisan here, you belong to one of these organized crafts.

baldurs-gate-hermit.name: Baldur's Gate Hermit
baldurs-gate-hermit.info: A hermit in a busy city may seem odd, but deep solitude can exist in the middle of a crowd. A small number of people in Baldur's Gate manage to find isolation amid all its noise and bustle.

baldurs-gate-noble.name: Baldur's Gate Noble
baldurs-gate-noble.info: The patriars of Baldur's Gate live in the Upper City, hosting galas and keeping fashion, walled off from the poorer districts. They know the courts of far lands well but little of the poor at their door. Their feature replaces Position and Privilege, though a

baldurs-gate-outlander.name: Baldur's Gate Outlander
baldurs-gate-outlander.info: People come to Baldur's Gate for profit, excitement, and cosmopolitan chances, but few grasp the tangled social mess waiting there. You arrive as an outsider, and no matter how long you stay, you will likely remain one, if you ever leave at all.

baldurs-gate-sage.name: Baldur's Gate Sage
baldurs-gate-sage.info: Baldur's Gate has a modest scholarly community around the High Hall libraries and temples of learning. Lecturers, researchers, and historians trade ideas with visiting scholars from Candlekeep. Arcane study also thrives, though wizards work alone in their own

baldurs-gate-sailor.name: Baldur's Gate Sailor
baldurs-gate-sailor.info: Sailors founded Baldur's Gate, and its harbor remains its heart. Several patriars descend from old captains, the Lower City's trade rests on the port, and river traffic sets the Outer City's pace. Sailors are as common here as the cobblestones, so this backgro

baldurs-gate-soldier.name: Baldur's Gate Soldier
baldurs-gate-soldier.info: Many kinds of soldiers walk the streets of Baldur's Gate, including mercenaries, private guards, Watch soldiers, and members of the Flaming Fist. You are one of them, and you earn your keep with arms and discipline.

baldurs-gate-urchin.name: Baldur's Gate Urchin
baldurs-gate-urchin.info: Orphans and runaways gather in the Outer City, chasing passersby in ragged crowds to beg for scraps. In the Lower City, urchins are often recruited into the Guild's lowest ranks or forced into dangerous work by ruthless masters.

bandit-defector.name: Bandit Defector
bandit-defector.info: skills Deception, Survival; tool Gaming Set or Musical Instrument (choose one); gear Knife, Cooking Pot, Winter Blanket, an object that was your cut of a robbery, Common Clothes, Pouch, 10 GP

beast-hunter.name: Beast Hunter
beast-hunter.info: skills Animal Handling, Survival; tool Leatherworker's Tools; gear Dagger, Spear, Leatherworker's Tools, Hunting Trap, Traveler's Clothes, 5 GP

beggar.name: Beggar
beggar.info: skills Insight, Persuasion; tool Disguise Kit; gear Dagger, Disguise Kit, Robe, 12 GP

bejeweled-conclave-spy.name: Bejeweled Conclave Spy
bejeweled-conclave-spy.info: In public you pose as a courtier, mediator, or entertainer, but your real talent is gathering secrets. The enchanters of the Bejeweled Conclave trained you to use charm, wit, and a little magic to infiltrate groups, uncover information, and broker deals.

boros-legionnaire.name: Boros Legionnaire
boros-legionnaire.info: You serve the Boros Legion, devoted to angels and to bringing justice and peace to Ravnica's streets. You might be a true believer moved by the angels and the downtrodden. You might instead be a cynic who followed a parent, fell for a recruiter's promises, or

botanist.name: Botanist
botanist.info: skills Nature, Survival; tool Herbalism Kit; gear Book (field guide), Herbalism Kit, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes (overalls), 17 CR. Option B is 50 CR

carouser.name: Carouser
carouser.info: You grew up in the heart of a big city like Baldur's Gate, spending countless evenings in taverns, theaters, parlors, and gambling dens. You read people well and learn their secrets over cards or at fine parties. You have been thrown out of a few places, but o

celebrity-adventurers-scion.name: Celebrity Adventurer's Scion
celebrity-adventurers-scion.info: Your family name inspires fear and admiration, though you earned none of it. Songs celebrate your famous parent, who was seldom home and always talking of dragons and demons. The family fortune went to potions and ale, and everyone expects you to fight like yo

changeling-traveler.name: Changeling Traveler
changeling-traveler.info: skills Deception, Sleight of Hand; tool Thieves' Tools; gear 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Bedroll, 2 Pouches, Shiftweave, 10 GP

chapter-knight.name: Chapter Knight
chapter-knight.info: skills Animal Handling, Athletics; tool Musical Instrument (choose one); gear Dagger, Shield, Musical Instrument (same as above), Traveler's Clothes, 6 GP

chondathan-freebooter.name: Chondathan Freebooter
chondathan-freebooter.info: Chondath expects youths to serve four years in the military, but you resented that control. You gave up your nation and your name, then joined the first ship that would take you. You have roamed the Vilhon Reach ever since, with deep local ties and broad exper

city-watch.name: City Watch
city-watch.info: You served the community you grew up in as its first defense against crime, policing its people rather than facing outside enemies. You may have walked with Waterdeep's City Watch, Silverymoon's Silverwatch or Spellguard, or Neverwinter's Wintershield. Many to

clan-crafter.name: Clan Crafter
clan-crafter.info: The Stout Folk are famed for their craftsmanship, and you trained in that old tradition under a dwarf master, enduring long hours and sour treatment to earn your skill. You are probably a dwarf, but shield dwarf clans accept promising apprentices of any race.

clasp-member.name: Clasp Member
clasp-member.info: skills Deception; tool Disguise Kit, Forgery Kit or Thieves' Tools (choose one); gear None listed in the book. Ask your DM.

cloistered-scholar.name: Cloistered Scholar
cloistered-scholar.info: As a child you were curious while your playmates were rowdy. You went to one of Faerûn's great centers of learning, such as Candlekeep, the Vault of the Sages, or Silverymoon's Map House, and learned that knowledge outweighs gold. Now you leave to seek new lor

cobalt-scholar.name: Cobalt Scholar
cobalt-scholar.info: The Cobalt Soul is an order of monastic scholars who preserve knowledge and history across Exandria, based mainly in Zadash and Rexxentrum. You likely studied there as a pupil and adventure to broaden your mind. With your DM's leave, you could instead be an ex

cosmic-dawn-experiment.name: Cosmic Dawn Experiment
cosmic-dawn-experiment.info: The transmutation practices of the Bringers of the Cosmic Dawn have warped your body. You might have been caught in one of their experiments, or you might have joined and sought to improve yourself through magic. Either way, you now use your odd anatomy to you

courtier.name: Courtier
courtier.info: Once you held a position of some importance in a noble court or a bureaucracy, earned by talent rather than birth. You may have served in Silverymoon, Waterdeep, Baldur's Gate, Neverwinter, or Daggerford. Your old ties can help you and your companions, and the

covenant-of-the-grave-recruit.name: Covenant of the Grave Recruit
covenant-of-the-grave-recruit.info: Death has always fascinated you. You studied the morbid with members of the Covenant of the Grave, treating the macabre with scientific precision. Through this work you gained knowledge of medicine, necromancy, and history.

crucible-storm-chaser.name: Crucible Storm Chaser
crucible-storm-chaser.info: Your daredevil streak and hunger for thrills brought you to the Crucible Keepers, who study natural and magical disasters. You have handled molten glass and charged into the eye of a hurricane. You feel most alive when catastrophe is only steps away.

cult-initiate.name: Cult Initiate
cult-initiate.info: skills Arcana, Persuasion; tool Artisan's Tools or Musical Instrument (choose one); gear Arcane Focus (any), Art Object (worth 10 GP), the Artisan's Tools or Musical Instrument you chose, Hooded Lantern, 5 fla

dead-magic-dweller.name: Dead Magic Dweller
dead-magic-dweller.info: Anauroch's dead magic zones are hostile to casters and magical monsters, and that is why you settled there. Maybe Red Wizards hunted you, or you angered a djinni in Calimshan. After months or years, you came out stronger and wiser, knowing desert medicine and

dimir-operative.name: Dimir Operative
dimir-operative.info: You are a spy of House Dimir, dealing in secrets and lies, infiltrating guilds and stealing from journals and minds alike. Your missions sometimes only hide another strike or spread fear. You keep a false identity as a member of another guild, which supplies y

disciple.name: Disciple
disciple.info: skills Persuasion, Religion; tool Calligrapher's Supplies; gear Book (prayer), Calligrapher's Supplies, Fine Clothes, Holy Symbol, 5 GP

discredited-neural-tuner.name: Discredited Neural Tuner
discredited-neural-tuner.info: You once worked at Mordenheim Kinetics doing questionable work in its darkest depths, until something angered the powers above and you were punished. Company security dragged you to a waste chamber for failed experiments, but you escaped. Now you live as a dis

disgraced-raider.name: Disgraced Raider
disgraced-raider.info: skills Athletics, Nature; tool Navigator's Tools; gear Spear, Navigator's Tools, Traveler's Clothes, Dilapidated Rowboat, 8 GP

dragon-cultist.name: Dragon Cultist
dragon-cultist.info: You are an initiate of the Cult of the Dragon, found or brought into a local cell. You show its values of duplicity, secrecy, and determination. In return for your oath, the cult gave you fellow worshipers and resources for studying arcana and the occult.

emerald-enclave-caretaker.name: Emerald Enclave Caretaker
emerald-enclave-caretaker.info: You serve the Emerald Enclave by caring for those who protect the world. Alone or with others, you learned to track game, forage herbs, and predict weather. You use these skills to keep civilization and wilderness in balance and to destroy unnatural creatures.

envoy.name: Envoy
envoy.info: skills Insight, Persuasion; tool Calligrapher's Supplies; gear Dagger, Calligrapher's Supplies, Diplomatic Papers, Fine Clothes, Signet Ring, 10 GP

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.info: skills Athletics, Medicine; tool Smith's Tools; gear Dagger, Smith's Tools, Someone Else's Journal, Traveler's Clothes, 10 GP

exile.name: Exile
exile.info: skills Deception, Stealth; tool Disguise Kit or Forgery Kit (choose one); gear Disguise Kit or Forgery Kit (same as above), Igniter, Traveler's Clothes, 18 CR. Option B is 50 CR

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.info: skills Athletics, Survival; tool Navigator's Tools; gear Dagger, Navigator's Tools, Maps, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

exterminator.name: Exterminator
exterminator.info: skills Animal Handling, Medicine; tool Poisoner's Kit; gear Dagger, Poisoner's Kit, Hunting Trap, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

fabricated-mind.name: Fabricated Mind
fabricated-mind.info: You are the product of monstrous experimental neurotechnology, a wholly new mind rather than a copy. You woke sentient in the halls of Mordenheim Kinetics, with no idea who made you. Your synthetic nature pushes you to seek an identity, allies of similar origi

faceless.name: Faceless
faceless.info: You believe your class, people, family, or sins keep you from ever being a hero, yet you press on. You left your old face behind and took on a new persona, dramatic or subtle, literal or not. This background focuses on the hero beneath the mask.

faction-agent.name: Faction Agent
faction-agent.info: Many Faerûn factions ignore borders and act wherever needed, using listeners, smugglers, sellswords, and haven keepers. You served one as its hands, head, and heart, openly or in secret, before adventuring. You may keep your membership, and adventuring may eve

failed-merchant.name: Failed Merchant
failed-merchant.info: You came from a line of merchants or tried business yourself, but it all ended badly through bad luck, outside forces, or weak skill. You lost everything but gained experience and contacts. Your sense of commerce drew you toward Acquisitions Incorporated, wher

familiar-trainer.name: Familiar Trainer
familiar-trainer.info: A magical familiar bonded with you in youth and stayed beside you through adolescence. You cannot imagine life without your furry, feathery, scaly, or slimy friend. You learned to work as a team, and when adventure gets hard, your familiar reminds you of small

far-traveler.name: Far Traveler
far-traveler.info: Most people on the Sword Coast never travel more than a few miles from where they were born, but you come from a remote land few have heard of. You came for your own reasons. Local ways may seem strange, and you may be a figure of curiosity wherever you go.

fey-blessed.name: Fey-Blessed
fey-blessed.info: skills Arcana, Performance; tool Musical Instrument (choose one); gear Dagger, Musical Instrument (same as above), Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

fey-hostage.name: Fey Hostage
fey-hostage.info: skills Deception, Insight; tool One gaming set and one musical instrument; gear Fine Clothes, A flower whose petals never wilt, Musical Instrument (one of your choice), Pouch, 10 GP

feylost.name: Feylost
feylost.info: You vanished from your home plane as a child and grew up in the Feywild. Fey may have taken you kindly, you may have wandered in by chance, or evil Fey may have stolen you. You returned changed, haunted by the Feywild nearby, and you both fear and long for it.

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.info: You spent your life on fishing boats or searching the shallows for the sea's bounty. You may come from a family of fisher folk, or perhaps the work was a way out of a bad situation. Either way, you grew to love the sea, the craft, and the endless horizon.

flaming-fist-mercenary.name: Flaming Fist Mercenary
flaming-fist-mercenary.info: The Flaming Fist is Baldur's Gate's main law enforcement, a mercenary guild led by the city's grand duke. You served in it and learned to head off trouble with a hard stare and to take deadly blows. Its members are among the toughest warriors on the Sword Coas

folk-hero.name: Folk Hero
folk-hero.info: You come from humble roots, yet you are destined for more. Your home village already sees you as its champion. Your fate calls you to face the tyrants and monsters that menace ordinary people everywhere.

free-swords-mercenary.name: Free Swords Mercenary
free-swords-mercenary.info: skills Acrobatics, Athletics; tool Gaming Set (choose one); gear Dagger, Spear, Gaming Set (same as above), Robe, 10 GP

galactic-colonist.name: Galactic Colonist
galactic-colonist.info: skills Survival, Technology; tool ; gear Binoculars, Flashlight, Traveler's Clothes (duster), Utility Axe, 18 CR. Option B is 50 CR

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.info: You believe a little gold can turn into a lot, or into none. Good or bad, you cannot predict Lady Luck, who sometimes lifts you and sometimes drops you. Still, there is always someone willing to take a bet.

gate-warden.name: Gate Warden
gate-warden.info: You lived for a long time near a portal or in a place steeped in planar energy, like a gatetown in the Outlands. Sights that terrify or dazzle other people feel ordinary to you. You deal with Celestials and Fiends as easily as with any shopkeeper.

genie-touched.name: Genie Touched
genie-touched.info: Genie magic still lingers in your homeland, and one day your life crossed paths with a genie. It may have been a djinni in a lamp, a marid at an oasis, a dao, or an efreeti. The meeting left you sharp-eyed, smooth-tongued, and a little magical.

giant-foundling.name: Giant Foundling
giant-foundling.info: You are not a Giant, yet giants raised you, or you grew up in a land full of huge creatures. Some magic in your surroundings made you unusually large. You learned to channel giant strength, and you see the world from the viewpoint of someone used to towering n

golgari-agent.name: Golgari Agent
golgari-agent.info: You belong to the Golgari swarm, one small piece of a vast living system of decay and renewal. You grew up in the dark corners of the city where life's messy side shows. You feel no fear of death or the dead, only a fierce respect for the cycle.

grinner.name: Grinner
grinner.info: You are a Grinner of the Golden Grin, a secret network that began in Tal'Dorei and now operates from hidden bases across the Clovis Concord. Your group works to reach the top of the Dwendalian Empire. You aim to bring freedom and hope to the oppressed, and spr

grounded.name: Grounded
grounded.info: skills Athletics, Insight; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear Artisan's Tools (same as above), Walking Stick, a trinket from another culture, Traveler's Clothes, Pouch, 5 GP

gruul-anarch.name: Gruul Anarch
gruul-anarch.info: You come from the wild fringes of Ravnica, the ruined districts, rubble fields, and overgrown parks left outside the great city. Your people cling to the Old Ways and live close to nature and primal fury. The rest of the world, busy with progress, pays you lit

guild-artisan.name: Guild Artisan
guild-artisan.info: You belong to an artisan guild and work closely with other crafters in your trade. Your skill and wealth put you in the merchant class, free from feudal duties. You trained as an apprentice under a master, with your guild's backing, until you earned the rank o

harper.name: Harper
harper.info: You accepted an invitation to join the Harpers and swore to follow their code and serve the common good. You know when to work as a team and when to act alone. Veteran Harpers taught you secret melodies, watchwords, and sleight of hand to watch and thwart evil

haunted.name: Haunted
haunted.info: skills Arcana, Deception; tool ; gear Bedroll, Book (mythology), 5 Flares, Map, Tent, Traveler's Clothes, 14 CR. Option B is 50 CR

haunted-one.name: Haunted One
haunted-one.info: Your past haunts you, whether it came from one terrible event or a long run of pain. You have tried burying it and running from it, and nothing worked. No sword can cut it down and no spell can banish it, yet you keep going.

heretic.name: Heretic
heretic.info: skills Deception, Religion; tool Disguise Kit; gear Disguise Kit, Heretical Text, Holy Symbol, Traveler's Clothes, 10 GP

holo-influencer.name: Holo-Influencer
holo-influencer.info: skills Data, Performance; tool Gaming Set (Digital Games); gear Costume, Fine Clothes, Mirror, Perfume, 20 CR. Option B is 50 CR

horizon-weaver-initiate.name: Horizon Weaver Initiate
horizon-weaver-initiate.info: As a restless teenager you left home as soon as you could and went traveling. On the road you met the Horizon Weavers, adventurous conjurers. They taught you some of their teleportation magic to help you explore farther.

house-agent.name: House Agent
house-agent.info: You are tied to a dragonmarked house but have not yet shown a dragonmark. You may be family by blood or simply an employee. Your work has been running the house's business as the eyes, hands, and feet of its leaders, and you have friends, mentors, and rivals i

house-cannith-heir.name: House Cannith Heir
house-cannith-heir.info: You are a scion of House Cannith, which builds the marvels of the modern age. The house expects you to add to its success through invention, study, business, or diplomacy. A deep split inside the house troubles you, as three barons compete for leadership and y

house-deneith-heir.name: House Deneith Heir
house-deneith-heir.info: As an heir of House Deneith you trained for battle, though you neither chase it nor fear it. You value duty, honor, and the laws that serve when those fail. You may have guarded a minor dignitary, fought as a mercenary, or hunted fugitives as a marshal. You ex

house-ghallanda-heir.name: House Ghallanda Heir
house-ghallanda-heir.info: House Ghallanda raised you among comfort, good talk, fine drink, and tasty meals. You might be a witty, charming host who loves a warm hearth, or a schemer who uses trust to bend others. Adventure may let you learn foreign cuisines, grow your contacts, or save

house-jorasco-heir.name: House Jorasco Heir
house-jorasco-heir.info: House Jorasco teaches that sickness and wounds haunt the living and steal health and long life. You learned to fight them with magic and medicine, and to make sure you are paid well. You might be a gentle healer who avoids battle, or a cold specialist who know

house-kundarak-heir.name: House Kundarak Heir
house-kundarak-heir.info: You are proud of your Kundarak family and its work guarding the valuables of Khorvaire. The house leads among the clans of the Mror Holds and is known for professionalism, honor, and order. You may uphold that name, put your own honor first, or rebel against w

house-lyrandar-heir.name: House Lyrandar Heir
house-lyrandar-heir.info: As a Lyrandar heir, you count the wind as an ally and the sea and sky as your realm. Your house is rising thanks to its airship mastery. You may have worked as a sailor, navigator, shipwright, Raincaller, or airship crew, and the house may send you after pirat

house-medani-heir.name: House Medani Heir
house-medani-heir.info: Your life as a Medani heir centers on intrigue, but your job is stopping it. You see the world as a web of schemes and counterplots, and you use instinct to spot threats to your clients early. Your house prefers that no blade is ever drawn, rather than blockin

house-orien-heir.name: House Orien Heir
house-orien-heir.info: House Orien once connected Khorvaire with trade roads and lightning rails. The Last War broke those links and ended Galifar. Couriers still carry goods, and the house wants routes across the Mournland restored. Orien adventurers look into missing couriers, sto

house-phiarlan-heir.name: House Phiarlan Heir
house-phiarlan-heir.info: You grew up with wealth, fame, and beauty in House Phiarlan, yet you value knowledge and the power it gives most of all. You may be a performer or artist who listens for secrets while entertaining crowds. You may instead link up with the house's spy branch, th

house-sivis-heir.name: House Sivis Heir
house-sivis-heir.info: Your family has spent almost three thousand years keeping order, because communication holds civilization together. Your ancestors settled royal disputes and helped dragonmarked houses find their place. While other houses chase fame, Sivis plays a quiet, long

house-tharashk-heir.name: House Tharashk Heir
house-tharashk-heir.info: Other heirs live in luxury, but House Tharashk taught you to rely on yourself. The young house has little wealth and plenty of drive, and it has a destiny you share. In battle or conversation you act as a hunter who studies foes, finds weaknesses, and wins by

house-thuranni-heir.name: House Thuranni Heir
house-thuranni-heir.info: House Thuranni is young and built on espionage, so its leaders expect you to advance its interests whenever you can. Everything you did as the house found its footing was watched closely. Even the quietest artist or artisan in the house follows politics and pa

house-vadalis-heir.name: House Vadalis Heir
house-vadalis-heir.info: You grew up valuing both family and nature. You know how the Five Nations live but stay out of their games of status and ambition. You understand life's power and its mysteries, and your feel for nature lets you see through city folk's deceit without ever show

ice-fisher.name: Ice Fisher
ice-fisher.info: You come from a proud line of ice fishers in Ten-Towns, Icewind Dale. Pulling knucklehead trout from frozen lakes is not glamorous, but it pays honestly. You learned to sense the faintest tug on a line, and the hard work toughened your body and mind for advent

inheritor.name: Inheritor
inheritor.info: You are the heir to something precious, though not money. A single object was entrusted to you, perhaps by family, a friend, or a mentor. Learning of it changed your life and may have launched your adventures. It also brings danger from those who want to take

initiate.name: Initiate
initiate.info: You are an initiate working through the trials of the five gods, hoping for a glorious death in the final Trial of Zeal. Your talents and teachers pointed you toward close combat, ranged combat, or spellcasting. A truly worthy initiate stays well rounded, so m

inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
inquisitor.info: Inquisitors were once cathar detectives who looked into both ordinary and supernatural crimes, often in remote parishes, and who unmasked hidden werewolves. While Avacyn was trapped in the Helvault, they became brutal, executing suspects and holding unsanction

inquisitor-of-the-faithful.name: Inquisitor of the Faithful
inquisitor-of-the-faithful.info: skills Intimidation, Religion; tool Herbalism Kit; gear Club, Navigator's Tools, Book Containing Holy Rites, Holy Symbol, Interrogator's Tools, Manacles, Traveler's Clothes, 10

interpreter.name: Interpreter
interpreter.info: skills Insight, Performance; tool ; gear Ink, Ink Pen, Fine Clothes, Log Keeper, 10 sheets of Paper, 13 CR. Option B is 50 CR

investigator.name: Investigator
investigator.info: You pursue the truth without rest. You may have seen something strange or awful and need to understand it, or you may simply care about justice and honesty. Whether the case is a local crime or an eldritch conspiracy, you work to expose what others want hidden

izzet-engineer.name: Izzet Engineer
izzet-engineer.info: You bring an inventive mind, a love of magical technology, and endless energy to the research of the Izzet League. You likely start as an attendant, but you might rise to mage, alchemist, lab supervisor, or flamethrower-carrying scorchbringer. You embody the I

knight-of-solamnia.name: Knight of Solamnia
knight-of-solamnia.info: You trained as a Knight of Solamnia, a valorous warrior. Strict rules shape everything you do, and you work to follow them while protecting the weak and opposing evil. Honor matters to you as much as your own life.

knight-of-the-gauntlet.name: Knight of the Gauntlet
knight-of-the-gauntlet.info: You did not want to spend your days reading scripture in a quiet temple, so you joined the Order of the Gauntlet as a holy warrior. You scorn evil, stand by your fellow knights, and care for survivors of war. You swore to rest only when justice outshines chaos

knight-of-the-order.name: Knight of the Order
knight-of-the-order.info: You belong to a knightly order sworn to a vital cause. Faerun has many such orders, and most welcome all kinds of folk who will fight and die for the goal, not just armored nobles. Some serve a god, some a government, and others follow a philosophy.

lapsed-inquisitor.name: Lapsed Inquisitor
lapsed-inquisitor.info: skills Persuasion, Religion; tool Navigator's Tools; gear Club, Navigator's Tools, Disguise Kit, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

lawyer.name: Lawyer
lawyer.info: skills Deception, Persuasion; tool ; gear Book (legal reference), Fine Clothes, 10 CR. Option B is 50 CR

lords-alliance-vassal.name: Lords' Alliance Vassal
lords-alliance-vassal.info: You swore loyalty to a member city of the Lords' Alliance and pledged to increase safety and prosperity along the Sword Coast. You bring honor to your lord's house, whether by guarding trade roads for a Waterdeep merchant-lord or hunting monsters near Daggerfo

lorehold-student.name: Lorehold Student
lorehold-student.info: You spent your youth preparing for Lorehold College and read every book on its list for applicants. History is your great passion. You might dream of using magic to speak with famous figures of the past or your own ancestors, or to recreate the mighty magic of

lorwyn-expert.name: Lorwyn Expert
lorwyn-expert.info: You come from Lorwyn, the land of endless sunshine, or you have studied it closely. You see the creature Eirdu as the living sun and love whimsical adventures. You cherish loved ones, having watched some wander into Shadowmoor and fade. You stay brave and eage

low-worlder.name: Low-Worlder
low-worlder.info: skills Athletics, Survival; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear Artisan's Tools (same as above), Backpack, Rope, 10 Silver Pieces, Traveler's Clothes, 29 CR. Option B is 50 CR. Any 5th

luxonborn.name: Luxonborn
luxonborn.info: Every acolyte serves a god, but you serve the Luxon, whom you believe stands above godhood and made the cosmos. You study potential, which the Luxon embodies. Your Shelter of the Faithful feature covers all who revere the Luxon and all who practice dunamancy,

lyceum-scholar.name: Lyceum Scholar
lyceum-scholar.info: skills ; tool None; gear None listed in the book. Ask your DM.

lyceum-student.name: Lyceum Student
lyceum-student.info: skills ; tool Calligrapher's Supplies; gear Fine Clothes, Lyceum uniform, Calligrapher's Supplies, Pouch, 10 GP

mage-of-high-sorcery.name: Mage of High Sorcery
mage-of-high-sorcery.info: The Mages of High Sorcery noticed your magical talent, and you trained with this group that studies magic and prevents its misuse. You may yet face the dangerous test for full membership. Your passion likely leans you toward the White, Red, or Black Robes. The

malenti.name: Malenti
malenti.info: skills Deception, Insight; tool Thieves' Tools, Poisoner's Kit or Forgery Kit (choose one); gear The equipment of a background tied to the person you consumed, or 50 GP instead

marine.name: Marine
marine.info: You trained to fight on sandy beaches and rocky shores. You led midnight raids from fast ships whose names frighten your enemies. The sea is your second home, rain is your shelter, and crashing waves are your battle cry.

marked-for-death.name: Marked for Death
marked-for-death.info: skills Arcana, Survival; tool ; gear Dagger, Flare, 50 sheets of Paper, Sacrificial Brand Eldritch Carving (Scarified), Traveler's Clothes, 44 GP. Option B i

medic.name: Medic
medic.info: skills Insight, Medicine; tool ; gear Healer's Kit, 2 Hypodermic Needles, Log Keeper, Traveler's Clothes (scrubs), 32 CR. Option B is 50 CR

mercenary.name: Mercenary
mercenary.info: skills Acrobatics, Athletics; tool ; gear Bandolier, Igniter, Tactical Vest, Traveler's Clothes (fatigues), Utility Axe, 15 CR. Option B is 50 CR

mercenary-veteran.name: Mercenary Veteran
mercenary-veteran.info: You fought battles for coin and know the risk of life and limb for a share of treasure. Now you hope for greater rewards as an adventurer, or for freedom to pick your own work. You have gripping battlefield tales, maybe from the Zhentarim, Mintarn's soldiers,

miner.name: Miner
miner.info: skills Athletics, Technology; tool ; gear 2 Flashlights, Rope, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes (overalls), 25 CR. Option B is 50 CR

mist-wanderer.name: Mist Wanderer
mist-wanderer.info: You once had a home, until the Mists rose and pulled you into a Domain of Dread. Since then you have drifted from domain to domain, braving the shifting Mists in search of a way back. The cursed realms changed you, but fellow wanderers offer comfort.

moonwell-pilgrim.name: Moonwell Pilgrim
moonwell-pilgrim.info: You grew up in the Moonshae Isles, honoring the blessed land, its gods, and the shrines called moonwells. You set out on a pilgrimage to visit and commune with every moonwell. On the way you gathered folk songs, painted lovely vistas, and picked up a bit of pr

mulhorandi-tomb-raider.name: Mulhorandi Tomb Raider
mulhorandi-tomb-raider.info: You grew up under living god-kings, hearing tales of ancient empires and buried cities full of forgotten treasure. You decided to explore the crypts, tombs, and pyramids of your homeland yourself. Your goal is to reclaim your people's relics from those who are

mutated-commuter.name: Mutated Commuter
mutated-commuter.info: You rode a gloomy train to work each day until it crashed. You crawled out of the wreck unhurt but changed, your body mutated by the supernatural violence. You woke near Mordenheim Kinetics, surrounded by sea and misty forest, and entered its campus seeking he

myriad-operative.name: Myriad Operative
myriad-operative.info: You are no common cutpurse. You belong to the Myriad, the greatest crime syndicate in Exandria, with bases in every major city outside Eastern Wynandir. You have criminal contacts and allies, but also rivals and bosses who would sacrifice you. Anywhere the Myr

mythalkeeper.name: Mythalkeeper
mythalkeeper.info: Mythals are great magical powers that can reshape the Weave and even reality. Most are ancient, and many are damaged or dormant. You come from the Dalelands, where you likely met your first mythal in Myth Drannor. You travel Faerun seeking other ruined places

natural.name: Natural
natural.info: skills Insight, Stealth; tool Thieves' Tools; gear 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Gaming Set (any), Bedroll, Pouch, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP

one-of-the-taken.name: One of the Taken
one-of-the-taken.info: skills Arcana, Nature; tool Woodcarver's Tools; gear Woodcarver's Tools, Herbalism Kit, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

orzhov-representative.name: Orzhov Representative
orzhov-representative.info: The Orzhov Syndicate promises immense wealth and moves money from Ravnican society up to the top of its hierarchy. As a low-ranking functionary, you hope to keep as much as you can from the money passing through your hands. That is how you plan to climb until

outlander.name: Outlander
outlander.info: You grew up in the wilds, far from towns and technology. You saw herds bigger than forests, endured weather no city dweller could imagine, and loved being the only thinking creature for miles. The wild runs in your blood, whether you were a nomad, explorer, he

phantasmic-circus-trouper.name: Phantasmic Circus Trouper
phantasmic-circus-trouper.info: You found a home with the Phantasmic Circus, as a performer or a circus hand. You traveled the world bringing magic and wonder to eager crowds. In that life you learned some illusion magic and sharpened your talent for performance and misdirection.

physician.name: Physician
physician.info: skills Medicine, Nature; tool Herbalism Kit; gear Dagger (scalpel), Healer's Kit, Herbalism Kit, Bandages, Book of Remedies, Jar of Leeches, Robe, 10 GP

pioneer.name: Pioneer
pioneer.info: skills Athletics, Survival; tool Carpenter's Tools or Mason's Tools (choose one); gear Dagger, Carpenter's Tools or Mason's Tools (same as above), Mule and Cart, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

pit-fighter.name: Pit Fighter
pit-fighter.info: skills Athletics, Performance; tool Gaming Set (choose one); gear Dagger, Spear, Gaming Set (same as above), Robe, 10 GP

plaintiff.name: Plaintiff
plaintiff.info: Accidents seem to follow Acquisitions Incorporated operatives. You were left barely alive by one such incident, which a magistrate blamed on the company. Before the ruling, they offered you a job and promised training in swordplay or spellcasting. You left you

planar-philosopher.name: Planar Philosopher
planar-philosopher.info: You follow a philosophy that seeks to explain the planes or some hidden truth of the multiverse. Your conviction gives you strength, and you may draw on a network of like-minded thinkers, such as the factions of Sigil. You explore your ideas as you travel and

pox-touched.name: Pox-Touched
pox-touched.info: skills Intimidation, Medicine; tool Herbalism Kit; gear Herbalism Kit, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

prismari-student.name: Prismari Student
prismari-student.info: You are an artist preparing to practice your craft in the tradition of Prismari College. Your medium could be sculpture, dance, painting, music, drama, or architecture. You dream of fusing magic with creativity and bringing your grand artistic visions to life.

prisoner.name: Prisoner
prisoner.info: skills Deception, Sleight of Hand; tool Thieves' Tools; gear Dagger (shiv), Thieves' Tools, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

programmer.name: Programmer
programmer.info: skills Data, Investigation; tool Gaming Set (Digital Games); gear 6 cans of Krash, Interface Rig, Traveler's Clothes (hoodie), 22 CR. Option B is 50 CR

purple-dragon-squire.name: Purple Dragon Squire
purple-dragon-squire.info: You pledged yourself to protect Cormyr and hope to join the Purple Dragon Knights, an elite order. First you must serve as a knight's squire, and you found a liege to teach you their ways. You must prove yourself worthy of the order's ideals of glory, honor, a

quandrix-student.name: Quandrix Student
quandrix-student.info: You prepared for Quandrix College by solving its math problems for applicants over many years. You are drawn to the numbers and patterns that run through the natural world. You may lean toward mathematics or physics, or toward abstract studies in metaphysics,

rakdos-cultist.name: Rakdos Cultist
rakdos-cultist.info: You are a born performer who loves drama and the spotlight, and you honed your demanding skills until they look easy. You live for roaring applause and chaos in the streets. You also belong to a cult of Rakdos, a demon who loves violence and a good show, and y

rashemi-wanderer.name: Rashemi Wanderer
rashemi-wanderer.info: You wandered for years across the highlands of Rashemen, a harsh, windy heath dotted with ancient obelisks that imprison Fiends. Dragons, gnolls, and other deadly creatures live there. Friends are rare in such a lonely land, so you learned to keep strangers at

reconstructed-runaway.name: Reconstructed Runaway
reconstructed-runaway.info: You believed you had died. You awoke with your mind intact, saved as a perfect neuroprint, but in an artificial body built in the laboratories of Mordenheim Kinetics. The surgery carries a price you cannot or will not pay. To build a new life, you must escape

recovered-cultist.name: Recovered Cultist
recovered-cultist.info: skills Deception, Religion; tool None; gear Vestments and holy symbol of your old cult, Common Clothes, Pouch, 15 GP

reformed-cultist.name: Reformed Cultist
reformed-cultist.info: skills Deception, Religion; tool None; gear None listed in the book. Ask your DM.

released-thrall.name: Released Thrall
released-thrall.info: skills Perception, Stealth; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear Dagger, Artisan's Tools (same as above), Bag of Trinkets from Travels, Traveler's Clothes, 8 GP

revelry-pirate.name: Revelry Pirate
revelry-pirate.info: On the Menagerie Coast nearly everyone sails, but no pirates are as organized or infamous as the Revelry. You serve the Plank King and send him a share of your plunder on Darktow. If you left the crew, watch your back, since the Revelry punishes deserters unti

rewarded.name: Rewarded
rewarded.info: Your life was hard until a miraculous stroke of luck changed your fate. A kind deity may have granted your deepest wish, you may have drawn a powerful card from a Deck of Many Things, or a distant relative may have left you a fortune. You left your misery behi

rival-intern.name: Rival Intern
rival-intern.info: You interned at a rival of Acquisitions Incorporated and came to admire its ruthless efficiency. Maybe your old employer treated you badly, or you washed out. You may hope to use what you learned there to your advantage. Either way, you now bring your talents

ruined.name: Ruined
ruined.info: You once enjoyed luxury, love, and comfort, then lost everything. You may have been framed for crimes, had a monster wipe out your holdings, or drawn a destructive card from a Deck of Many Things. Desperation pushed you to adventuring because every other path

rune-carver.name: Rune Carver
rune-carver.info: You have devoted your life to runecraft, which giants first created and many peoples now use. A master may have taught you, or you may have learned from ancient engravings. You tap the power held in runes, usually Giant runes, though many carvers also use symb

salvager.name: Salvager
salvager.info: skills Perception, Technology; tool ; gear Backpack, Crowbar, Flashlight, Traveler's Clothes (jumpsuit), Wrenchinator, 4 CR. Option B is 50 CR

savant.name: Savant
savant.info: skills Arcana, History; tool Calligrapher's Supplies; gear Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 8 GP

scion.name: Scion
scion.info: skills Arcana, Investigation; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear The Artisan's Tools you chose, Ink, Ink Pen, 50 sheets of Paper, Tinker's Tools, Traveler's Clothes, 3 GP

scion-of-the-thaumaturge.name: Scion of the Thaumaturge
scion-of-the-thaumaturge.info: skills Arcana, Insight; tool Cartographer's Tools; gear Cartographer's Tools, Ink Pen, Parchment, Robe, 8 GP

scoundrel.name: Scoundrel
scoundrel.info: skills Sleight of Hand, Stealth; tool Thieves' Tools; gear Dagger, 2 Pouches, Thieves' Tools, Traveler's Clothes (streetwear), 20 CR. Option B is 50 CR

security-guard.name: Security Guard
security-guard.info: skills Athletics, Intimidation; tool ; gear Book (magazine), Holster, Manacles, Traveler's Clothes (uniform), 20 CR. Option B is 50 CR

seer-apprentice.name: Seer Apprentice
seer-apprentice.info: You apprenticed with the Seers of Sea and Sky and learned to read small omens in the clouds above and the depths below. Their rich network of libraries furthered your education. Now you travel the world and offer advice and aid to others.

selesnya-initiate.name: Selesnya Initiate
selesnya-initiate.info: You belong to a blessed community built on harmony, where nature and civilization live together by the will of the Worldsoul, Mat'Selesnya. In the Selesnya Conclave you share a longing for spiritual communion with the world. You want to spread that joy through

shadowmasters-exile.name: Shadowmasters Exile
shadowmasters-exile.info: You trained your whole life to join the Shadowmasters, the secretive thieves' guild that quietly rules Thesk. Beyond stealth and quick reflexes, you learned the ruthlessness needed to protect its secrets. One mistake got you expelled from the order, and now yo

shadowmoor-expert.name: Shadowmoor Expert
shadowmoor-expert.info: You know Shadowmoor, a dim and unruly land lit only by pale moonlight, either by birth or long study. Surviving there takes sharp wits or sheer courage. Life taught you that trust is scarce, and that choosing wrongly who to rely on can cost you everything.

shipwright.name: Shipwright
shipwright.info: You have spent your life around ships and the water you love. You fought in a war aboard great vessels and kept their hulls afloat with whatever you had. You also helped build a fishing boat that rescued a starving town, and you still dream of a prow you canno

siege-engineer.name: Siege Engineer
siege-engineer.info: skills Athletics, Intimidation; tool Gaming Set (choose one); gear Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set, Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP

silverquill-student.name: Silverquill Student
silverquill-student.info: You trained for years in writing and public speaking to earn a place at Silverquill College. Your studies center on language, literature, and the force of words. You learned that speech can reveal or hide the truth, and that magic can do the same in earnest.

simic-scientist.name: Simic Scientist

sleuth.name: Sleuth
sleuth.info: skills Insight, Investigation; tool ; gear Binoculars, Crowbar, Flashlight, Igniter, Log Keeper, Traveler's Clothes (trenchcoat), 18 CR. Option B is 50 CR

smuggler.name: Smuggler
smuggler.info: You move goods that others want hidden. You once floated a hundred swords past careless dock guards in fish barrels, and sold stolen elven wine at double its worth after a night on the river. At kinder moments, you carried refugees out of war zones or led herd

soul-channeler.name: Soul Channeler
soul-channeler.info: skills Arcana; tool Alchemist's Supplies, Poisoner's Kit; gear Alchemist's Supplies, Pocket knife, Chalk on a string, Chapbook of esoteric symbols, Common Clothes, Pouch, 10 GP

spacer.name: Spacer
spacer.info: skills Perception, Piloting; tool ; gear Flashlight, Omnitool, Traveler's Clothes (jumpsuit), Vent Tape, Wristwatch, 28 CR. Option B is 50 CR

spellfire-initiate.name: Spellfire Initiate
spellfire-initiate.info: You carry spellfire, a rare gift that draws raw power from the Weave. Using it strains the body badly. To handle this sacred force safely, you have trained both your mind and your body with great discipline.

spirit-medium.name: Spirit Medium
spirit-medium.info: Through odd rituals and chance meetings, you learned that you can link with the spirits of the dead and the damned. Your body lets them speak, and they sometimes grant you foresight. Their motives are not always kind, and their help leaves a lingering cost.

syndicate-smuggler.name: Syndicate Smuggler
syndicate-smuggler.info: skills History, Stealth; tool Forgery Kit; gear Forgery Kit, Chest (with false bottom), Parchment, Costume, 8 GP

technical-support.name: Technical Support
technical-support.info: skills Sleight of Hand, Stealth; tool Thieves' Tools; gear 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, Pouch, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP

technologist.name: Technologist
technologist.info: skills Arcana, Technology; tool Gaming Set (Digital Games); gear Interface Rig, Omnitool, Traveler's Clothes (overalls), Vent Tape, 13 CR. Option B is 50 CR

transformed-familiar.name: Transformed Familiar
transformed-familiar.info: skills Perception, Survival; tool Alchemist's Supplies; gear A trinket worn or carried by your previous form, Traveler's Clothes, Alchemist's Supplies, Explorer's Pack, Pouch, 5 GP

urban-bounty-hunter.name: Urban Bounty Hunter
urban-bounty-hunter.info: You earned your living tracking people for pay, but in the city rather than the wilds. You deal with criminals and rival hunters alike and keep contacts in both circles. You might be a rooftop thief-catcher, a street-wise informant, or a hunter who mingles wit

urchin.name: Urchin
urchin.info: You grew up poor and alone on the streets, with no one to feed or protect you. You fought for scraps, slept on rooftops, and learned to watch for thieves. You survived through cunning, speed, strength, or all three, and now have enough coin to live modestly fo

uthgardt-tribe-member.name: Uthgardt Tribe Member
uthgardt-tribe-member.info: You come from an Uthgardt tribe, where cooperation and old traditions kept your people strong while other kingdoms fell. Some bands settled and traded, but the totems of Uthgar called many back to the old ways. You may be adrift from a settled tribe or seek gl

vampire-devotee.name: Vampire Devotee
vampire-devotee.info: You served a vampire or a small group of them who shared a lair. They fed on your blood many times. You may have served eagerly, hoping to become a vampire yourself, or been charmed and left with fuzzy memories. Either way, that life has ended.

vampire-survivor.name: Vampire Survivor
vampire-survivor.info: You saw a vampire attack or lived through one. You may have fought in it or stood frozen in fear. Since then you stay alert for monsters and take pride in being prepared, so no vampire will surprise you or your friends again.

variant-city-watch.name: Variant City Watch
variant-city-watch.info: You belonged to the rarer branch of a community's watch, the investigators who solve crimes after they happen. Most settlements of decent size have one or two who can read a crime scene and trail a culprit. You are skilled in Investigation rather than Athletic

variant-criminal.name: Variant Criminal
variant-criminal.info: Your talents resemble those of a burglar or smuggler, but you honed them as an espionage agent. You may have worked as a sanctioned agent of the crown. Or you may have sold the secrets you uncovered to whoever paid the most.

variant-entertainer.name: Variant Entertainer
variant-entertainer.info: You turned combat into a show the crowd could enjoy, much like a minstrel or circus performer. You may also tumble or act. You can find work in any place that stages fights, such as an arena or a secret pit club, and may carry an unusual weapon like a trident

variant-guild-artisan.name: Variant Guild Artisan
variant-guild-artisan.info: Rather than craft goods, you belong to a guild of traders, caravan masters, or shopkeepers. You earn your living by buying and selling what artisans make, or the materials they need. You may have hauled cargo by ship, wagon, or caravan, or run a small shop of

variant-noble.name: Variant Noble
variant-noble.info: A knighthood is a modest noble rank, but it can lead higher. If you take this path, you gain retainers instead of a privileged position. One is a noble squire learning from you, while others might tend your horse or armor. You may carry a token from a lord or

variant-sailor.name: Variant Sailor
variant-sailor.info: You spent your youth serving a ruthless pirate captain who taught you how to survive among sharks and savages. You have robbed on the high seas and sent deserving people to watery graves. Many port towns know your unsavory name, and you may take Bad Reputation

vizier.name: Vizier
vizier.info: You serve your god as a vizier, handling the tasks that help initiates on their journey. In return, the gods let you into the afterlife with the God-Pharaoh's blessing. You hope to be the finest servant possible. Most viziers are clerics, druids, or paladins.

volstrucker-agent.name: Volstrucker Agent
volstrucker-agent.info: You belong to the Volstrucker, a secret order of arcane assassins serving the Cerberus Assembly. People in Dwendalian cities whisper of them as scourgers. Your duty is to silence those who threaten King Dwendal and the Assembly. The order recruits talented peo

wage-mage.name: Wage Mage
wage-mage.info: skills Investigation, Persuasion; tool Artisan's Tools (choose one); gear Artisan's Tools, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 32 GP

ward-of-the-sheltering-hands.name: Ward of the Sheltering Hands
ward-of-the-sheltering-hands.info: Bad luck brought you to the Sheltering Hands, a kind organization that defends the downtrodden. It helped you get back on your feet and taught you some protective magic. Its members hope you will one day shelter others in need.

waterdhavian-noble.name: Waterdhavian Noble
waterdhavian-noble.info: You come from one of Waterdeep's great noble families, known across Faerun as eccentric, spoiled, and very rich. People expect certain things from your surname. You may be the rebel who prefers dungeons to balls, or a champion defending your family's legacy, a

whitestone-rifle-corps.name: Whitestone Rifle Corps
whitestone-rifle-corps.info: skills ; tool None; gear None listed in the book. Ask your DM.

wildspacer.name: Wildspacer
wildspacer.info: You were raised in Wildspace, among asteroid miners, moon farmers, and other hardy folk. You may come from a distant settlement like the Rock of Bral, or have worked a spelljamming ship loading cargo and scraping the hull. That life has made you brave against

wind-touched.name: Wind-Touched
wind-touched.info: skills Acrobatics, Performance; tool Wind Musical Instrument (choose one); gear Wind Musical Instrument (same as above), Ornate Cloak, Symbol of the Wind, Common Clothes, Pouch, 10 GP

witchlight-hand.name: Witchlight Hand
witchlight-hand.info: As a youth you slipped into the Witchlight Carnival and stayed, working behind the scenes with the other hands. The carnival visits many worlds, but you see little of them. You barely know its owners, Mister Witch and Mister Light. The routine now feels dull,

witherbloom-student.name: Witherbloom Student
witherbloom-student.info: As a child you tried simple alchemy, hoping to enter Witherbloom College. Your reading centers on the life sciences, including biology and necromancy. Brewing odd medicinal mixtures, studying monster anatomy, and cataloging swamp plants are the studies you mig

worthless-husk.name: Worthless Husk
worthless-husk.info: skills Stealth, Survival; tool ; gear Dagger, Sewer Grate Key, Traveler's Clothes, 5 GP. Option B is 10 GP

zhentarim-mercenary.name: Zhentarim Mercenary
zhentarim-mercenary.info: Maybe you needed coin, wanted a family, or just excel at getting jobs done by any means. You joined the Zhentarim, the Realms' most notorious mercenary guild. Its leaders call it a family, though it is full of dishonesty and corruption. You sharpened your cunn

subjects.investigator: An adult investigator kneeling over a body in a sunny canal-side alley, magnifying lens and notebook, onlookers at the edge.
